name: com.certifyau/mcp
title: CertifyAU — Australian AML/CTF Screening
description: Free Australian AML/CTF screening across DFAT Sanctions, OpenSanctions PEPs, and ASIC Insolvency.

tools.name: screen_entity
tools.description: Screen an Australian company or entity against DFAT Consolidated Sanctions and ASIC Published Insolvency Notices for AUSTRAC AML/CTF Tranche 2 due diligence. Free 10/day per IP without API key; uncapped with X-API-Key.

entity_name.description: Legal or trading name of the Australian entity (e.g. Acme Pty Ltd).

tools.name: screen_person
tools.description: Screen an individual against DFAT Consolidated Sanctions and OpenSanctions Global/Domestic PEPs for AUSTRAC AML/CTF Tranche 2 compliance. Free 10/day per IP without API key; uncapped with X-API-Key.

full_name.description: Full legal name of the person (e.g. Jane Elizabeth Citizen).

tools.name: get_compliance_pulse
tools.description: Fetch the latest weekly DFAT Consolidated Sanctions and ASIC Published Insolvency counts and week-on-week deltas. No API key or rate-limit credit required.
